description: This Java class, GaugesGridElement, manages UI components for displaying either a SensorGauge or a SensorLiveGraph within a GUI panel. It provides methods to switch between gauge and live graph views, creating and configuring Swing components based on configuration data.

classes.name: GaugesGridElement
classes.description: A UI component class that manages a panel displaying either a sensor gauge or a live graph, allowing switching between views based on configuration.

methods.name: createLiveBarElement
methods.description: Creates a panel with a live graph view and a menu item to switch to gauge mode.

methods.name: createGauge
methods.description: Creates a gauge view for a specific sensor, including a menu item to switch to live graph mode.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Static method that returns a UI component (gauge or live graph) based on the configuration.
